map.A 营收 600 万、B 300 万、C 100 万，行业总 1000 万 →: A revenue 6 million, B 3 million, C 1 million, industry total 10 million gives A 60%, B 30% and C 10%; A leads, but B+C at 40% combined still has room to catch up.
map.去年营收 200 万占 20%，今年 260 万但行业扩到 1500 万 → 份: Last year revenue 2 million was a 20% share; this year 2.6 million but the industry grew to 15 million, so share fell to 17.3% - volume up, share down, which calls for caution.
map.份额用营收还是销量算？: Should share be measured by revenue or volume?
map.两者都行，含义不同。营收份额看金额话语权，销量份额看走量能力，高端品两者差异大。: Either works, but they mean different things. Revenue share shows pricing power, volume share shows throughput, and the two diverge widely for premium products.
map.份额下降一定是坏事吗？: Does a falling share always mean bad news?
map.不一定。行业高速扩张时份额降但绝对收入涨，属正常；若份额和收入同降才是真预警。: Not necessarily. When an industry expands fast, absolute revenue can rise while share falls, which is normal; a drop in both share and revenue is the real warning.
